notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Highscore added
notes.content:
Unleash your competitive spirit and embark on an exhilarating adventure with the latest update for 4 Seasons Runner! We're thrilled to introduce the highly anticipated [b]highscore system[/b], giving you the chance to climb the ranks, set new records, and become a legend in the game. But wait, there's more! We've also added a convenient [b]mute audio button[/b], allowing you to personalize your gameplay experience and immerse yourself in the captivating world of 4 Seasons Runner like never before. Get ready to push your limits, chase glory, and embrace the excitement of the seasons!

Even more exciting news! Now, with the latest update, [b]scores [/b]in 4 Seasons Runner are [b]no longer decimal-based[/b], adding a new level of clarity and competitiveness to your gameplay. Experience the thrill of achieving whole number scores as you strive for greatness and chase new records in this captivating adventure!

By the way, take advantage of the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] and grab [b]4 Seasons Runner[/b] at a fantastic [b]60% discount[/b]. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to gift it to a friend for an extraordinary gaming adventure!
